summary: Verified new Aktuelles feature end-to-end on frontend. /aktuelles route loads (HTTP 200), hero heading + 3 CTAs + hero-3d-cards render. News section shows 2 news cards including news-card-news-cdu-michelle-kraft; clicking news-more-* opens news-modal with delegation persons (Ömer Altun, Gülbanu Özden) and closes via news-modal-close. Events section renders 4 event cards linking to /events/<id>. Blog 3D slider renders 4 cards; blog-next/blog-prev work. All three Letzte Aktualisierung badges (news-updated/events-updated/blogs-updated) present. Home page: home-aktuelles-teaser is the FIRST child of <main> (top 72px, above all other sections), with teaser-card-news/event/blog and teaser-all-link -> /aktuelles. Header has Aktuelles link (desktop + mobile menu). Footer Schnellzugriff contains Aktuelles link. Feeds JSON HTTP 200. Mobile viewport 390px renders correctly and Aktuelles reachable via mobile menu. No page/runtime errors observed.
